fusions.name: Head-Down Rush
fusions.desc: A charge that deals 12 damage to everything in a cone 3.5 tiles ahead, knocks each enemy back 3 tiles and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Loosed Scree
fusions.desc: Kicks loose a stone that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 25% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Staring Contest
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Planted Hooves
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
